literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe fluorescent-protein insertions (mCherry at residue 391, YFP at an unspecified position) in the M3-M4 cytoplasmic loop of full-length α7 nAChR. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, the M3-M4 loop spans residues 318–469 and is entirely intracellular. No ledger line reports any tag insertion in an extracellular region of CHRNA7 (the large N-terminal ectodomain 23–230, the short EC2 loop 281–295, or the C-terminal tail 491–502). Because the ledger provides zero extracellular insertion evidence, zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: mCherry inserted at residue 391 in the M3-M4 cytoplasmic loop (318–469); construct retains functional properties but the site is intracellular, not a surface tag site.
YFP inserted into a structurally disordered region of the M3-M4 cytoplasmic loop; no specific residue named; intracellular, not a surface tag site.
